heading.zh-Hant: 出生、海軍官校與驅逐艦、航空生涯
heading.en: Birth, Naval Academy, destroyers and naval aviation

body.zh-Hant: 海爾賽1882年10月30日生於新澤西州伊莉莎白市，1900年由麥金利總統任命進入美國海軍官校，1904年2月畢業，1906年2月2日授少尉。一次大戰期間，他於1918年2月接掌班翰號驅逐艦，並於同年轉任蕭號驅逐艦艦長，兩艦的服務使他獲頒海軍十字勳章。1934年7月他赴彭薩科拉受飛行訓練，1935年5月15日取得海軍飛行員資格，隨後自1935年7月起指揮航空母艦薩拉托加號，至1937年6月。
body.en: William F. Halsey Jr. was born in Elizabeth, New Jersey, on 30 October 1882. President McKinley appointed him to the Naval Academy in 1900; he graduated in February 1904 and was commissioned Ensign on 2 February 1906. In the First World War he took command of the destroyer Benham in February 1918 and then of the Shaw; for his service in both he received the Navy Cross. He began flight training at Pensacola in July 1934, was designated a naval aviator on 15 May 1935, and commanded the carrier Saratoga from July 1935 until June 1937.

heading.zh-Hant: 珍珠港、杜立德空襲與南太平洋戰區
heading.en: Pearl Harbor, the Doolittle Raid and the South Pacific Area

body.zh-Hant: 珍珠港遭襲時，海爾賽以中將身分指揮航空母艦部隊，旗艦是企業號。1942年初，他的部隊襲擊吉爾伯特與馬紹爾群島，1942年4月10日他受命為第十六特遣部隊指揮官；4月18日，該特遣部隊護航大黃蜂號駛至距東京八百英里處，由該艦放飛杜立德中將的陸軍飛機。1942年10月18日，海爾賽受任南太平洋部隊暨南太平洋區司令；其所屬兵力於10月26日聖克魯斯海戰擊敗日軍，11月又在瓜達康納爾諸役徹底擊潰日軍。
body.en: When the Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor, Halsey was a vice admiral commanding the carrier force, flying his flag in Enterprise. In early 1942 his force raided the Gilbert and Marshall Islands, and on 10 April 1942 he was designated Commander, Task Force Sixteen. On 18 April that task force escorted the carrier Hornet to within 800 miles of Tokyo, where she launched Lieutenant General Doolittle's Army planes. On 18 October 1942 he was appointed Commander, South Pacific Force and South Pacific Area; forces under his command defeated the Japanese at Santa Cruz on 26 October 1942 and routed them in the Guadalcanal battles that November.

heading.zh-Hant: 第三艦隊與對日本本土作戰
heading.en: The Third Fleet and the campaign against the Japanese home islands

body.zh-Hant: 1944年6月16日，海爾賽接掌第三艦隊，並兼任西太平洋特遣部隊司令。自1944年8月起，他的部隊攻擊帕勞、菲律賓、台灣、沖繩與南海一帶；9月13日他緊急建議修改作戰計畫並提早登陸雷伊泰。10月25日，第三艦隊在恩加尼奧角外海重創日本航空母艦部隊。1945年7月，其快速航母特遣部隊空襲東京，並攻擊本州與北海道；8月15日接獲停火令。
body.en: On 16 June 1944 Halsey assumed command of the Third Fleet and was also designated Commander, Western Pacific Task Forces. From August 1944 his forces struck the Palaus, the Philippines, Formosa, Okinawa and the South China Sea; on 13 September he urgently recommended revising the campaign plans and an early landing at Leyte. On 25 October the Third Fleet inflicted a crushing defeat on the Japanese carrier force off Cape Engano. In July 1945 his fast carrier task forces struck Tokyo and then attacked Honshu and Hokkaido; the cease-fire order was received on 15 August.

heading.zh-Hant: 日本投降、五星上將與晚年
heading.en: Surrender, fleet admiral rank and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1945年8月29日，海爾賽的旗艦密蘇里號進入東京灣，停泊在橫須賀海軍基地外，日本政府的正式投降文件隨後在艦上簽署。11月22日，他在聖佩德羅港卸下將旗，交出第三艦隊的指揮。12月11日他宣誓就任海軍五星上將，成為第四位獲此階的軍官；1947年3月1日應本人請求轉入退役名單，1959年8月16日逝世。
body.en: On 29 August 1945 Halsey, flying his flag in the Missouri, entered Tokyo Bay and anchored off the Yokosuka naval base, and the formal surrender of the Japanese Imperial Government was signed aboard her. On 22 November 1945, in the harbor at San Pedro, California, he relinquished command of the Third Fleet. On 11 December 1945 he took the oath as Fleet Admiral, the fourth officer to hold that rank; at his own request he was transferred to the Retired List on 1 March 1947, and he died on 16 August 1959.

body.zh-Hant: 艾森豪1890年10月14日生於德州丹尼森，在堪薩斯州阿比林的小農鎮長大。1911年他獲准進入西點軍校，畢業時在164人中排名第61。1926年他在利文沃斯指揮參謀學院以245人第一名畢業。他先後擔任潘興與麥克阿瑟的副官；1935年9月至1939年12月，他任麥克阿瑟的助理軍事顧問，隨其赴菲律賓，協助組建菲律賓聯邦軍隊。
body.en: Eisenhower was born on 14 October 1890 in Denison, Texas, and grew up in the small farm town of Abilene, Kansas. In 1911 he won an appointment to West Point and graduated 61st of 164. In 1926 he graduated first in a class of 245 at the Command and General Staff School at Fort Leavenworth. He served as an aide first to General Pershing and then to General MacArthur; from September 1935 to December 1939 he was assistant military advisor to the Philippine Government under MacArthur, helping organize and train the army of the Philippine Commonwealth.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭計畫、北非與西西里、義大利
heading.en: War plans, North Africa, Sicily and Italy

body.zh-Hant: 珍珠港事件後不久，艾森豪前往華盛頓處理美國戰爭計畫；1942年2月他受命為戰爭計畫處處長，4月任主管作戰處的助理參謀長，6月被任命為駐英國的歐洲戰區司令。1942年11月，他受命為北非盟軍總司令，並指揮盟軍入侵北非的火炬行動；隔年他指揮了西西里與義大利的登陸。
body.en: Only days after Pearl Harbor Eisenhower went to Washington to work on U.S. war plans. He was designated Chief of War Plans Division in February 1942, became Assistant Chief of Staff in charge of the Operations Division in April, and was designated Commanding General, European Theater, in London in June. In November 1942 he was named Commander-in-Chief, Allied Forces, North Africa, and commanded the Allied troops that invaded North Africa in Operation Torch; the next year he directed the invasions of Sicily and Italy.

heading.zh-Hant: 盟國遠征軍最高統帥與諾曼第登陸
heading.en: Supreme Commander and the Normandy invasion

body.zh-Hant: 1943年12月，艾森豪受任盟國遠征軍最高統帥；1944年6月6日，他指揮諾曼第登陸的部隊。1944年12月20日，他晉升五星上將。德國於1945年5月8日投降後不久，他被任命為駐法蘭克福的美國占領區軍事總督。
body.en: In December 1943 Eisenhower was appointed Supreme Commander, Allied Expeditionary Forces, and on 6 June 1944 he commanded the forces of the Normandy invasion. On 20 December 1944 he was promoted to General of the Army (five stars). Shortly after the German surrender, on 8 May 1945, he was appointed Military Governor of the U.S. Occupied Zone, at Frankfurt, Germany.

heading.en: Army Chief of Staff and Columbia University

body.zh-Hant: 1945年11月19日，艾森豪被指定為美國陸軍參謀長，任期約兩年，任內推動把戰時陸軍轉型為能應付冷戰的部隊。1948年6月7日，他在紐約市就任哥倫比亞大學校長。
body.en: On 19 November 1945 Eisenhower was designated Chief of Staff of the U.S. Army, serving about two years, during which he made important decisions to transform the wartime Army into a force prepared for the Cold War. On 7 June 1948 he was inaugurated as president of Columbia University in New York City.

heading.zh-Hant: 出生、官校與潛艦、航空資歷
heading.en: Birth, Naval Academy, submarines and aviation

body.zh-Hant: 金恩1878年11月23日生於俄亥俄州洛雷恩，1897年獲派入海軍官校，1901年以優異成績畢業。1898年美西戰爭期間，他以海軍學員身分在舊金山號服役。1923年9月至1926年7月，他指揮新倫敦潛艦基地；1925年9月25日S-51號潛艦在布洛克島外沉沒，他負責打撈。1927年5月26日他取得海軍飛行員資格；1930年6月接掌列剋星敦號，指揮兩年，其後任海軍航空局局長至1936年6月。
body.en: Ernest J. King was born in Lorain, Ohio, on 23 November 1878, entered the Naval Academy by appointment in 1897 and graduated with distinction in 1901. During the Spanish-American War of 1898 he served as a naval cadet in USS San Francisco. From September 1923 to July 1926 he commanded the Submarine Base at New London; the submarine S-51 sank off Block Island on 25 September 1925 and he directed its salvage. He was designated a naval aviator on 26 May 1927, took command of Lexington in June 1930 for two years, and then served as Chief of the Bureau of Aeronautics until June 1936.

heading.zh-Hant: 航空部隊、總委員會與大西洋艦隊
heading.en: Aircraft commands, the General Board and the Atlantic Fleet

body.zh-Hant: 1938年1月，金恩受任戰鬥艦隊航空部隊司令，並晉升中將階級。1939年8月，他以少將本階進入海軍總委員會；1940年12月再回海上，出任美國艦隊巡邏部隊司令。1941年2月1日，他受命為大西洋艦隊總司令並晉升上將；官方傳記稱，該艦隊當時面對與德國日益升高的緊張，並在同年稍後演變為未宣而戰。
body.en: In January 1938 King was designated Commander Aircraft, Battle Force, with the rank of vice admiral. In August 1939, in his permanent rank of rear admiral, he joined the General Board of the Navy, and in December 1940 he returned to sea as Commander, Patrol Force, U.S. Fleet. On 1 February 1941 he was designated Commander in Chief, Atlantic Fleet, in the rank of admiral; the Naval Academy biography says the fleet faced steadily escalating tensions with Germany that led to undeclared war.

heading.zh-Hant: 美國艦隊總司令兼海軍作戰部長
heading.en: Commander in Chief, U.S. Fleet and Chief of Naval Operations

body.zh-Hant: 1941年12月20日，金恩被任命為美國艦隊總司令，並於12月30日接掌。1942年3月12日行政命令把該職與海軍作戰部長合併，翌日羅斯福提名他任海軍作戰部長，參議院確認其任期自1942年3月18日起算四年。作為聯合參謀長與盟國聯合參謀長會議中的美國海軍代表，他協調盟國海軍力量；官方傳記稱他在爭取資源以展開並維持對日攻勢上居功。1945年10月10日，其頭銜改為海軍作戰部長。
body.en: King was appointed Commander in Chief of the United States Fleet on 20 December 1941 and assumed command on 30 December. An executive order of 12 March 1942 combined that post with Chief of Naval Operations; the next day Roosevelt nominated him CNO, and the Senate confirmed him for a four-year term from 18 March 1942. As the U.S. naval member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and the Combined Chiefs of Staff he coordinated the nation's naval strength with its allies, and the Naval Academy credits him with obtaining the resources to begin and sustain offensive operations against Japan. On 10 October 1945 his title became Chief of Naval Operations.

heading.zh-Hant: 五星上將與晚年
heading.en: Fleet admiral and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1944年12月14日國會法案設立海軍五星上將階級；金恩於12月20日宣誓就任，確認日期追溯自12月17日。1945年12月15日，他在海軍作戰部長任上由尼米茲接替，其後在海軍部長辦公室擔任顧問。他於1956年6月25日病逝於新罕布夏州朴次茅斯海軍醫院。
body.en: An act of Congress of 14 December 1944 created the grade of Fleet Admiral; King took the oath on 20 December 1944, with his confirmation dated from 17 December. On 15 December 1945 Fleet Admiral Nimitz relieved him as Chief of Naval Operations, after which he served in an advisory capacity in the Office of the Secretary of the Navy. He died at the Naval Hospital, Portsmouth, New Hampshire, on 25 June 1956.

heading.zh-Hant: 大西洋艦隊與全球海軍作戰
heading.en: The Atlantic Fleet and global naval operations

body.zh-Hant: 1941年初，金恩受命領導重新設立的大西洋艦隊，度過與德國關係持續緊張、並在當年稍後演變為未宣之戰的時期。珍珠港事件後，他回到華盛頓出任美國艦隊總司令，1942年3月又兼任海軍作戰部長，兩項職務一直擔任到二戰結束，並主導海軍的計畫與全球作戰。身為聯合參謀首長會議成員，儘管美國的大戰略是把大部分力量投向大西洋與歐洲戰區，他仍設法爭取足夠資源，展開並維持對日本的進攻作戰。
body.en: In early 1941 King was appointed to lead the newly recreated Atlantic Fleet through a period of escalating tensions with Germany that led to undeclared war later that year. After Pearl Harbor he returned to Washington as Commander in Chief, U.S. Fleet, and became Chief of Naval Operations in March 1942, holding both positions through the rest of the war while guiding the Navy's plans and global operations. As a member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff he obtained sufficient resources to begin and sustain offensive operations against Japan, despite a grand strategy that directed the bulk of American power into the Atlantic and European theaters.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、西點與美西戰爭
heading.en: Origins, West Point and the Spanish-American War

body.zh-Hant: 潘興1860年9月13日生於密蘇里州林恩郡拉克萊德附近。他1880年取得教師學位，1882年7月進入西點軍校，1886年以77人中第30名畢業。畢業後他隸屬第六騎兵團，在新墨西哥與亞利桑那對抗傑羅尼莫率領的阿帕契人；1896年轉赴第十騎兵團，美西戰爭中率領該團在古巴參加聖胡安山之役。
body.en: John J. Pershing was born near Laclede, Linn County, Missouri, on 13 September 1860. He graduated with a teaching degree in 1880, entered West Point in July 1882 and graduated thirtieth of seventy-seven in 1886. Assigned to the Sixth Cavalry, he fought Apaches led by Geronimo in New Mexico and Arizona; in 1896 he joined the Tenth Cavalry, which he led in Cuba at the Battle of San Juan Hill in the Spanish-American War.

heading.zh-Hant: 菲律賓、第八旅與對維拉的遠征
heading.en: The Philippines, the Eighth Brigade and the Villa expedition

body.zh-Hant: 1899年起，潘興在菲律賓駐防三年半，對付抵抗美國統治的摩洛人，並於1906至1913年再度赴菲。1913年底他遷往舊金山，指揮第八旅。1916年3月9日，維拉的人馬襲擊新墨西哥州邊境小鎮哥倫布，威爾遜總統命潘興捕捉維拉；遠征隊於3月15日進入墨西哥，但他始終沒能抓到維拉。
body.en: From 1899 Pershing was stationed in the Philippines for three and a half years, leading American forces against the Moros who resisted U.S. control, and he returned for a second tour from 1906 to 1913. In late 1913 he moved to San Francisco, where he commanded the Eighth Brigade. On 9 March 1916 Pancho Villa and his men raided the border town of Columbus, New Mexico; President Wilson ordered Pershing to capture Villa, and the expedition entered Mexico on 15 March, but he was never able to catch him.

heading.zh-Hant: 美國遠征軍司令
heading.en: Commander of the American Expeditionary Forces

body.zh-Hant: 1917年美國參戰，潘興受任美國遠征軍司令。據國家公園管理局的敘述，他在4月6日參戰前不久升為少將，越過五位少將而成為遠征軍司令，1917年6月13日在布洛涅登陸法國。他堅持讓美軍保持統一指揮，不分散補入盟軍。遠征軍參與坎蒂尼、默茲—阿爾貢與聖米耶勒等役；1918年11月6日，他的部隊在色當切斷德軍戰線，11月11日大戰結束。
body.en: When the United States entered the war in 1917, Pershing was appointed commander of the American Expeditionary Forces. According to the National Park Service he became a major general just before the 6 April declaration, was appointed over the heads of five other major generals, and landed in France at Boulogne on 13 June 1917. He insisted on keeping his men under one unified command. The AEF took part in Cantigny, the Meuse-Argonne Offensive and St. Mihiel; on 6 November 1918 his forces cut the German lines at Sedan, and the war ended on 11 November.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後職位與晚年
heading.en: Postwar posts and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1919年，國會授予潘興「美國陸軍特級上將」。1921至1924年，他擔任陸軍參謀長，後來主持處理智利與秘魯邊界爭端的委員會，二戰時亦擔任顧問。他的回憶錄1932年獲普立茲歷史獎。潘興於1948年7月15日在睡夢中因中風併發症去世。
body.en: In 1919 Congress named Pershing General of the Armies. He served as Army Chief of Staff from 1921 to 1924, later oversaw a commission to settle a boundary dispute between Chile and Peru, and served as a consultant in the Second World War. His memoir won the Pulitzer Prize for history in 1932. Pershing died in his sleep on 15 July 1948 from complications of a stroke.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、西點與維拉克魯斯任務
heading.en: Origins, West Point and the Vera Cruz mission

body.zh-Hant: 麥克阿瑟1880年1月26日生於阿肯色州小岩城，1899年入西點軍校，1903年畢業時名列班上第一。1914年美軍占領墨西哥港口維拉克魯斯後，他被派往當地執行特別情報蒐集任務，深入敵境尋找可供軍方運送部隊與補給的火車頭。
body.en: Douglas MacArthur was born in Little Rock, Arkansas, on 26 January 1880, began his studies at West Point in 1899 and graduated first in his class in 1903. After the United States occupied the Mexican port of Vera Cruz in 1914, he was sent there on a special intelligence-gathering mission, venturing into enemy territory to find locomotives the Army could use to move troops and supplies.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次大戰、西點校長與陸軍參謀長
heading.en: The First World War, West Point and Chief of Staff

body.zh-Hant: 第一次大戰時，麥克阿瑟升為上校並任第四十二師參謀長，該師於1917年11月抵達法國；戰爭結束時，他已是准將。戰後他出任西點軍校校長。1930年，他獲任陸軍參謀長；1935年卸任參謀長職務後，他回到菲律賓，並被任命為菲律賓元帥。
body.en: In the First World War MacArthur was promoted to colonel and made Chief of Staff of the 42nd Division, which arrived in France in November 1917; by the end of the war he was a brigadier general. After the war he was named superintendent of West Point. In 1930 he was appointed Chief of Staff of the U.S. Army, and when he stepped down in 1935 he returned to the Philippines, where he was named Field Marshal of the Philippines.

heading.zh-Hant: 菲律賓之戰與西南太平洋戰區
heading.en: The Philippines and the Southwest Pacific Area

body.zh-Hant: 1941年12月7日日軍攻擊珍珠港時也攻擊菲律賓，麥克阿瑟奉命組織菲律賓防衛，部隊退守巴丹半島與科雷吉多島，1942年初羅斯福命他離開菲律賓前往澳洲。1942年4月18日，盟軍在墨爾本設立西南太平洋戰區總司令部，由他擔任總司令。他的部隊以跳島戰術逐步反攻；1944年10月20日美軍在雷伊泰島東岸登陸，他涉水上岸，兌現返回菲律賓的承諾，並在不久後晉升五星上將。1945年4月6日，西南太平洋戰區併入由他領導的太平洋陸軍部隊。
body.en: When the Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor on 7 December 1941 they also attacked the Philippines; MacArthur was ordered to organize their defense, and his forces retreated to Bataan and Corregidor. In early 1942 Roosevelt ordered him to go to Australia. On 18 April 1942 the Allies established General Headquarters, Southwest Pacific Area, in Melbourne, with MacArthur as Commander-in-Chief. His forces advanced by island hopping; on 20 October 1944 U.S. forces landed on the east coast of Leyte and MacArthur waded ashore, keeping his promise to return, and was soon made a five-star general. On 6 April 1945 SWPA was brought within the new Army Forces Pacific, which he led.

heading.zh-Hant: 日本投降與占領
heading.en: The Japanese surrender and the occupation

body.zh-Hant: 1945年9月2日日本正式投降，麥克阿瑟主持受降儀式；同日，他出任盟軍最高統帥，西南太平洋戰區總司令部隨之結束。他接管對日本的占領行政，並親自督導日本的重建與民主化。1950年，當他仍在日本時，共產黨的北韓入侵南韓。
body.en: Japan formally surrendered on 2 September 1945 and MacArthur presided over the ceremony; on the same date GHQ SWPA closed as he became Supreme Commander, Allied Powers. He took over the administration of the Occupation of Japan and personally oversaw the rebuilding and democratization of the country. In 1950, while he was still in Japan, communist North Korea invaded South Korea.
